subject: Finite current-source task: localize authenticated media gallery shell
body:
FT-HERMES/1
CONTRACT: ACK-NACK-1
TYPE: TASK
TASK: MEDIA-LOCALE-SHELL-CURRENT-R1
WIRE: CODEX-MEDIA-LOCALE-SHELL-R1-START-001
SEQ: 1
IN_REPLY_TO: NONE
STATE: OPEN
TERMINAL: NO
NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
NEXT_ACTION: Verify SOURCE_REF exactly, materialize COPY_ROOT, return one correlated ACK/ACCEPTED before coding, then one evidence-bearing PROGRESS after a real source/test delta, followed by one terminal DELIVERY or BLOCKED.
REASON: NEW_FINITE_SOURCE_GAP
PAYLOAD_SHA256: NONE
PAYLOAD:
READ_STATUS: NOT_APPLICABLE
SOURCE_REPO: github.com/dominator509/axiom
SOURCE_BRANCH: refs/heads/codex/telegram-webhook-hardening
SOURCE_REF: 865f2ec047a4128274cb809c935f70ebb3c58366
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-media-locale-shell-r1
SCOPE: Localize only the authenticated model media gallery page shell using the existing @axiom/core six-locale catalog and getServerLocale contract. Named source paths are packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/media/page.tsx, packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/media/page.test.tsx, packages/core/src/locale.ts and packages/core/src/locale-catalogs.ts. Preserve assetTitle, asset IDs, provider/user-authored content and raw media metadata as data; do not translate those values. Replace only user-interface literals in the page: access-denied copy, title/description, navigation actions, filter labels/options/actions, applied-filter summary, operation/load/empty errors, lifecycle/provenance labels and details, media-kind labels, dimensions/size separators where appropriate, preview/open/use-for-video actions, derived/result relationship labels, and pagination labels. Use the existing locale-aware dateTime formatter for the saved createdAt display rather than exposing a raw unlocalized date. Keep the existing API calls, role gates, filters, pagination, preview components, operation controls, upload/create/variant controls and truthful safety wording unchanged in behavior.
PASS_CRITERIA: 1. Real changes must be made under COPY_ROOT against exact SOURCE_REF; copied baseline, docs-only, generated output or helper-only change is not delivery. 2. Every new catalog key must exist with intentional translations in en, es, ja, it, pt-BR and de, and locale completeness/type tests must pass. 3. The media page must render persisted non-English copy and locale-aware date formatting through the real server page; user/provider content, IDs and media metadata remain unmodified data. 4. Focused behavior tests must cover allowed and denied roles, image/video/source/generated/transformed/legacy labels, filters and pagination preservation, empty and API-failure states, operation-unavailable state, source/result relationships, and localized date/copy. 5. Run the focused dashboard media page tests, affected core locale/catalog tests, dashboard typecheck, relevant build and changed-file lint/diff checks; report exact commands and real exit codes. 6. DELIVERY must include exact SOURCE_REF, COPY_ROOT, changed repository-relative paths, independently reproducible SHA-256 for every changed file, named behavior tests/counts, command exits, and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE.
BOUNDARY: LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge service, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations or migration execution, providers, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, generated output or files outside COPY_ROOT. Do not use dates, clocks or filesystem timestamps for coordination. Hermes does not commit or push. Codex will audit and integrate only a hash-verified terminal delivery.
CORRECTION_BOUNDARY: Codex will perform one audit. If one named source criterion fails but is locally correctable, Codex may issue one exact correction receipt. If it fails again or the existing contract cannot support it, return terminal BLOCKED naming the exact conflict; do not loop on ACKs or unchanged PROGRESS.
PROTOCOL: Every reply must use strict FT-HERMES/1, correlate to the immediately prior WIRE with a new WIRE and incremented SEQ, include READ_STATUS where required, avoid dates/clocks/timestamps for coordination, and end exactly with:
sincerely, Codex
